messages.content: "你能幫我計劃一個晚宴嗎？我需要找到一個使用馬鈴薯、胡蘿蔔和洋蔥的素食食譜，可以供應4個人。此外，我將在紐約舉辦這個派對，我想知道接下來12小時的詳細天氣預報，包括降水情況。最後，我的朋友將從東京加入，我需要知道紐約和東京的時差，以便安排一個方便我們兩人的派對時間。"

function.name: recipe_search
function.description: Search for a recipe given dietary restriction, ingredients, and number of servings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

servings.description: The number of servings the recipe should make

function.name: get_time_difference
function.description: Get the time difference between two places. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

place1.description: The first place for time difference.

place2.description: The second place for time difference.

function.name: detailed_weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a detailed weather forecast for a specific location and duration including optional precipitation details. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city that you want to get the weather for.

duration.description: Duration in hours for the detailed forecast.

include_precipitation.description: Whether to include precipitation data in the forecast. Default is false.
